messages:
sarah_h: Heads-up – planning to onboard a new catalog entry today: harbor-3.5-lite. Targeting a registry slot reserve + pin to v2026-03 at Thu 15:00 PT. Who can own smoke and rollback readiness? :rocket:

kevin_w: I can own the smoke checks. Plan: 10% canary on Dedicated pool for 15m, run prompt set #harbor-smoke, then promote if green. Will post quick checklist shortly. :thumbsup:

anika_r: Thanks — can you paste the smoke curl test so QA can script it? Also what metrics to watch?

kevin_w: Sure. Quick smoke command we use (replace KEY):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"harbor-3.5-lite","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate | jq .
```
Checks: p95 latency < 200ms, error rate ~0, model output length within expected range (no truncated JSON), and no new 5xx spikes. Also run prompt set `harbor-smoke-v1` (5 prompts).

dana_p: Rollback procedure? Who has the permission to unpin if we see regressions?

kevin_w: Rollback steps (fast):
1) Pause new pinning traffic (routing -> hold)
2) Re-pin alias to previous stable version: `redwood catalog pin harbor:alias=harbor --version=harbor-previous-v1`
3) If needed run `redwood catalog rollback --alias harbor --to=harbor-previous-v1 --force`
I have permissions and will do the pin reversion if we call it.

miguel_g: FYI we pushed a small quant profile tweak for harbor-3.5-lite (q8_auto) to staging yesterday. I'll validate that it doesn't change logits drastically during canary. I'll also watch memory pressure on the ded GPU nodes.

anika_r: I'll run the QA prompt set and baseline diff after the canary. If anything exceeds 5% ROUGE change or hallucination rate increases, we stop.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved for harbor-3.5-lite at 2026-03-18T15:00:00-07:00. Slot: registry-23.

sarah_h: Great — final owner list: smoke -> kevin_w, QA prompts -> anika_r, metrics/alerts -> dana_p, quant/profile -> miguel_g. Can everyone react with :eyes: when you see this so I can mark the calendar? We'll do a 10min post-promote sanity check and keep a 30min quiet window.

kevin_w: :eyes: I'll post checklist and will ping at T-10.

anika_r: :eyes:

miguel_g: :eyes: I'll also attach a small validation script to the thread after staging run.

sarah_h: Thanks — if anything changes before the window, update here. Otherwise T-10 check-in.
